name: Named ownership question
text:
The disaster recovery plan is owned by the **DevOps Engineering team**, with **David Kim** listed as the owner/approver. This information is found in the document's header section, which states: "Owner: David Kim, DevOps Engineer."

The plan also identifies specific roles and responsibilities within the DR team, including:
- Incident Commander: Sarah Chen (Primary), David Kim (Backup)
- Technical Lead: David Kim (Primary), Marcus Johnson (Backup)
- Database Admin: Jessica Walker (Primary), Priya Sharma (Backup)
- Communications: Brian Clark (Primary), Nicole Harris (Backup)
- Customer Success: Lisa Anderson (Primary), Kevin Wilson (Backup)

The document indicates it was last reviewed in June 2023 and is reviewed quarterly with updates as infrastructure changes.
